full_prompt_en: A square monochrome studio photograph shows a young person in close right-facing profile against an uninterrupted black background. Their eyes are closed, lips relaxed, and face softly modeled in pale silver-gray. Several layers of translucent white fabric wrap the head and fall around the shoulders, with a ruffled floral band running over the crown. Fine folds cross the forehead and temple, while the outer veil lifts away from the cheek and drapes diagonally into the lower left. The fabric is extremely thin, so its overlapping layers create shifting degrees of opacity: bright folds at the top, smoky semitransparent passages around the neck, and near-black areas where it merges with the background. The light comes from upper left and slightly in front, tracing the bridge of the nose, upper lip, and the small peaks of the ruffles. The far side of the head recedes into soft shadow. There is no visible room, prop, or horizon; all attention rests on the relation between smooth skin and airy cloth. The framing is tight but gives the veil space to billow on the left. The image feels sculptural, hushed, and ceremonial, with restrained contrast and a delicately graded silver-print surface.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形单色影棚照片在不间断的黑色背景前，近距离呈现一位年轻人物朝右的侧面。眼睛闭合，嘴唇放松，面部以浅银灰柔和塑形。数层半透明白布裹住头，并落在肩周，头顶有一道褶皱的花形饰带。细褶横过额头和太阳穴，外层薄纱从面颊旁扬起，斜向垂到左下。布料极薄，层叠产生不断变化的透明度：顶部褶处发亮，颈旁呈烟雾般半透明，融入背景处近乎黑色。光从左上和稍前方进入，勾出鼻梁、上唇和饰带褶峰。头的远侧进入柔影。没有可见房间、道具或地平线；全部注意力落在平滑肌肤与轻盈布料的关系上。取景很近，却给左侧薄纱飘动留出空间。画面有雕塑感、静默和仪式感，反差克制，银盐印相表面带细致渐层。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome studio photography organized by sculptural smooth planes and translucent folded material against absolute black. Pale silver highlights fade through smoky gray layers into deep shadow. Soft upper-side light defines selective contours without hard edges, while overlapping sheer textures create depth through changing opacity. The composition remains quiet, close, and nearly weightless, with fine silver-print gradation.
style_prompt_zh: 单色影棚摄影，以雕塑般平滑平面与半透明折叠材质对照纯黑底色。浅银亮部经过烟灰色层次融入深影。柔和上侧光有选择地勾出轮廓而无硬边，重叠薄透肌理凭透明度变化形成纵深。构图安静、贴近且近乎无重力，带细腻银盐印相渐层。
theme_en: A veiled face in pale grayscale against black
theme_zh: 黑色背景前一张被薄纱包裹的浅灰面孔
name: Olivier Valsecchi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
